resources.string: Presses the Claude app\'s dictation and narration controls when you twist the phone, so a walk can be spent talking to Claude with the phone in a pocket.
Shown while the twist gesture is being listened for
Twist to speak, twist again to send
This phone has no gyroscope, so the twist gesture cannot be recognised.
Without it nothing can read or press the Claude app.
Needed to keep the screen on behind the Claude app, and to shield the pocket from its own touches.
Without the exemption a long session may be cut short.

Android 13 and later refuses this switch to an app that did not come from an app store, and shows “Restricted setting — for your security, this setting is currently unavailable” in its place. Take Settings → Apps → Claude Twist → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and the switch works. Installing over adb does not avoid this.

Open the Claude app on the conversation you want to talk to, start the session, and pocket the phone. One twist starts speech input; the next sends it. The finished response is read aloud, and a twist during it starts the next turn.
Shield the screen from pocket touches, and dim it

A Bluetooth headset\'s media buttons go to whatever is playing — the Claude app, while it reads a response. The one press that escapes is redial, which the headset sends as a call: this app can answer for that call, cancel it, and step the loop instead.
If this app is not there to answer — killed, role revoked, or too slow — the call is placed, and the button rings the last number you dialled. Emergency numbers are never diverted.
Read a dial attempt during a session as a trigger
Needed before Telecom will ask this app about an outgoing call. Only the headset button needs it; the twist does not.
Used to tell an emergency number from an ordinary one. Without it no dial attempt is ever diverted, so the headset button does nothing.
How much of a twist it takes. Start with one twist; if a pocket drives the Claude app by itself, demand more.

The content descriptions the Claude app publishes for the controls this app presses. If a Claude app release renames one, put the app in the state that shows it, read the screen below, and correct the field.
